pull.title: feature_taproot: sample tx version border values more
pull.body: Currently if the version 3 is selected for an otherwise standard spender, the test will fail. It's unlikely but possible, so change the test to update expectations and sample more aggressively on border values to instigate failures much quicker in the future if another version is made standard.

events.message:
feature_taproot: sample tx version border values more

Currently if the version 3 is selected for an otherwise
standard spender, the test will fail. It's unlikely but
possible, so change the test to update expectations and
sample more aggressively on border values to instigate
failures much quicker in the future if another version is
made standard.
